items.title: 8.3.2 Effective Navigation and Managing Digital Information

source_refs.note: Topic 8.3.2 with the class activity (PDF 200, printed 197).

blocks.text: Search effectively with specific keywords and advanced options, and use database filters for date, author or subject. Then manage what you find: save and organize copies of articles, take notes on key points and keep track of sources. Digital folders, note-taking apps and reference managers keep research organized; for example, a folder of article PDFs with a document of key quotes and ideas. Many universities, including in Pakistan, give free access to thousands of journals online (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: find three academic articles, save them in a folder, summarize each and explain how you organized them. Why keep track of sources while researching?
blocks.explanation: So you can cite every source correctly, avoid plagiarism and find the material again quickly when writing.

items: Navigate with keywords and filters; manage with folders, notes and reference records.
